decisions.reason: The finned tube is a core component of the firm's air cooler business and was presented on its own page. That makes it embedded in the firm's established offer and engineering investment, so dropping it would write off sunk know-how without any clear evidence of failure.

The enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on the firm's tube and exchanger competence, and the firm committed to them visibly in 2018–2019. With no evidence of lasting poor results, management would justify continuing rather than reversing its earlier decision.
